title: Canonical Binary Codec Repair
prompt: Fix `codec.py` so `Codec.dumps`/`loads` correctly round-trip Python values with canonical, compact encoding. The codec uses varint/ZigZag for ints, length-prefixed UTF-8 for str/bytes, little-endian IEEE-754 for floats, and back-references for shared/cyclic structures. Dumps must be deterministic and compact; loads must validate input and preserve identity/cycles. Read the starter source and its docstrings for the full contract — the prompt is intentionally brief.
